description: Publora is a social media management platform for scheduling and managing posts across multiple social networks. It also offers an MCP server so AI assistants can operate Publora tools in natural language.
summary: Publora exposes a server-to-server REST API at `api.publora.com/api/v1` and a remote MCP server at `mcp.publora.com`; both use the same user-generated Publora API key, with optional managed-user scoping on workspace REST calls.
